basic_profile.bio: I'm a 35-year-old software engineer based in Chicago, originally from the East Coast. I've been dealing with OCD since childhood and have been on various SSRIs since 2016. When I'm not working or managing my mental health, I love diving into the mysteries of Red Dead Redemption 2 or re-exploring the classic game EarthBound. I'm also a huge fan of procedural dramas, with Chicago PD being a particular favorite. My typical online hours are late evenings, especially after winding down from work. I'm currently single, focusing on personal growth and mental wellness.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have been working in software development for over a decade. My knowledge about mental health comes from personal experience and extensive reading on the topic, as well as years of psychotherapy.
